name: California State Preschool Program
description: Free or low-cost preschool for income-eligible families with children ages 3-4
fullDescription: The California State Preschool Program provides free or low-cost, high-quality preschool education to income-eligible families, preparing 3- and 4-year-olds for kindergarten success.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free or low-cost part-day and full-day preschool
- For children ages 3-4
- Developmentally, culturally, and linguistically appropriate curriculum
- Kindergarten readiness focus
- Parent education and referrals to health and social services
- Includes meals and snacks
howToGetIt:
1. Check income eligibility requirements
2. Find participating preschool providers (school districts, colleges, and community agencies)
3. Complete application process
4. Provide income documentation
5. Submit required paperwork
6. Enroll child once approved
keywords: state preschool, free preschool, pre-K, ages 3-4, kindergarten readiness, early education, low-income, CSPP
